scope.authenticationPopup: single app-owned WebviewWindow with opener semantics

database SSO and personal library authentication remain inside Sidera
ordinary links open tabs and true authentication popups use one modal
academic discovery, database direct and catalog flows remain usable

notes: Automated validation used no real institution request and no paid Provider call.

rustfmt passed for the new browser core/runtime and institution runtime modules; full-workspace formatting remains outside this package because the preserved dirty tree contains pre-existing formatting drift.
Download cancellation is best-effort through WebView stop; the Finished event finalizes deletion of incomplete files.
Shared-session reset clears an existing browser or legacy institution WebView and falls back to an invisible one-shot WebView when no institution surface has been created yet.
Raw tokenized download URLs are kept only in runtime memory, so retry after restart returns to provenance rather than persisting credentials.

The latest visible native Tauri candidate opened the shared institution browser shell and loaded the Wuhan University Library home page inside the same Sidera window; arbitrary address entry, authentication popup routing, downloads and restart reuse remain unverified.
